title: Palangka Raya Fire Threatens 40 Homes; Alkon Water Pump from Nurul Ashri Supports Firefighting
excerpt: A fire in Palangka Raya threatened around 40 homes. An alkon (portable water pump) provided by Nurul Ashri helped the firefighting effort at the site.
seoTitle: Palangka Raya Fire Threatens 40 Homes - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: A fire in Palangka Raya threatened around 40 homes. An alkon (portable water pump) provided by Nurul Ashri helped the firefighting effort at the site.
html:
Palangka Raya — A fire approaching a residential area on Jalan Bakung Merang, RT 02/RW 01, Tanjung Pinang Urban Village, Pahandut District, Palangka Raya City, Kalimantan Tengah, left residents worried that the flames would spread to their houses. Around 40 homes were under threat from the fire.

In this emergency, firefighting efforts were carried out with the involvement of volunteers and the local community. An alkon (portable water pump) and its accessories, provided by Nurul Ashri, were also put to use to help tackle the fire on the ground.

Fire in Palangka Raya Threatens Residential Area

The fire in the Jalan Bakung Merang area worried nearby residents because the flames were approaching their homes. The situation prompted various parties to work together on the response in order to reduce the risk of the fire spreading to residents' houses.

Rizal of Karang Taruna (the local youth organization) said the situation had caused panic in the community.

“Residents panicked because the fire was already close to the settlement. We were worried it would spread to the houses. That is why we worked together on the response so that the fire would not spread any further.”

Alkon Water Pump Support from Nurul Ashri for Firefighting

In the effort to tackle the fire, an alkon pump and its accessories, funded by a donation from Nurul Ashri, were used to help with the firefighting.

This equipment support is one form of contribution to the emergency response, especially when a fire has the potential to threaten the safety of residents and the residential environment.

Naufal Fajrul of Relawan Nusantara said the equipment support meant a great deal in helping the response on the ground.

“When a fire is already close to residents' homes, every effort to tackle it means a great deal. The alkon pump and accessories from Nurul Ashri helped us respond to conditions on the ground. We hope this joint effort can help protect residents and reduce the risk of the fire spreading to the settlement.”

Volunteers and Medical Team Stand Ready to Help Residents

Two volunteers and two volunteer medical personnel also took part in the response. Besides supporting the firefighting effort, the medical team stood by to provide health assistance if needed by residents or by volunteers on duty.

The involvement of volunteers and the readiness of the medical team are part of the effort to support the community's safety while the response is under way.

Collaboration to Reduce Fire Risk

Nurul Ashri's support through the alkon pump and its accessories shows the importance of donors' contributions in supporting the response to emergencies. Collaboration among donors, volunteers, the community, and local stakeholders is expected to help reduce the risk of fires that threaten residential areas.

Through this support, the aid delivered is expected to bring real benefits to the firefighting effort and the protection of residents in Palangka Raya. Let's keep supporting communities and volunteers amid the karhutla (forest and land fires) in Kalimantan.

Luaskan Manfaat
